title: The Boot
description: Whenever you would deal [blue]4[/blue] or less unblocked attack damage, increase it to [blue]5[/blue].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Applies to powered attack damage dealt by the player to enemies. Damage less than 5 (but greater than 0) is increased to 5. Triggers the Flash visual effect when activating.
